target.outcome: county ischemic-stroke mortality among adults aged 65 years or older
target.geography: U.S. counties and county equivalents, excluding Puerto Rico, American Samoa, Guam, and U.S. Virgin Islands
target.effect_scale: adjusted linear-regression change in deaths per 100,000 per 1 ug/m3 PM2.5

substitutions.reanalysis: CDC public CSV offers all-stroke, age-adjusted age 35+, 2018-2020
substitutions.reason: This public extract cannot reproduce the target outcome; it was retained only as evidence, not used to fit a substitute model.

substitutions.reanalysis: EPA AQS parameter 88101 county monitor averages, 2018-2020
substitutions.reason: Independent public exposure source required; monitoring covers only a subset of counties.
Joint public reconstruction of all stated covariates was not completed because target outcome and coverage already failed.

coverage.notes: CDC public outcome extract has 3,226 county records. EPA AQS PM2.5 has 647 counties with any observation and 612 with all 2018-2020 observations; 612 is 19.0% of the article's stated 3,142 all-county target. Outcome definition also differs materially.

blockers: Available public CDC outcome extract is all-stroke age 35+ for 2018-2020, not ischemic stroke age 65+ for 2016-2020.
Independent EPA AQS monitor PM2.5 covers only 612 counties in all three 2018-2020 years, insufficient to represent the article's national all-county analysis.
The specified adjusted model cannot be executed without material outcome, coverage, and covariate substitutions.
